source.title: Lurgan Mail, 15 April 1899, p. 6 ("Election Results: Armagh Co. Council Returns"); party labels from the Northern Star, 15 April 1899, p. 5, and the Portadown News, 15 April 1899, p. 8; figures checked against those two and the Portadown News, 8 April 1899, p. 5
source.publisher: Lurgan Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every figure read from the Lurgan Mail page image; party labels and the alternative figures noted on some divisions read from the Northern Star page image (the two papers print different figures for several divisions)

note: First election of the county council under the Local Government (Ireland) Act 1898; polled 6 April 1899 and counted the next day at the County Courthouse, Armagh, before J. G. Sharkey, sub-sheriff.
